## 3-4 Point

AKA komoku. The 3-4 point favors territory. In this regard, its efficiency is between that of the star and the 3-3 point. Its effectiveness is maximized when the focus is on the corner. Since the 3-4 point is often considered to be the best play for a steady approach to the game, the 3-4 point has been favored by professionals (and AI) over the years. Even so, it lacks the star point's potential for influence and rapid center development. (pp. 6; see also Ishigure Ikuro—In the Beginning, p. 11.)
